# PCA tidyverse style

## Loading Libraries

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false

library("tidyverse")
library("broom")
library("cowplot")
```

## Load Data

The data is downloaded from wilkelab

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false

biopsy <- read_csv("https://wilkelab.org/classes/SDS348/data_sets/biopsy.csv")
```

## Creating PCA fit variable

```{r}
print(biopsy)
```

```{r}
pca_fit <- biopsy |> 
  select(-outcome) |> 
  prcomp(scale = TRUE)
```
